newsitem.title: USA: Mobil to sell data center in U.K.
newsitem.headline: Mobil to sell data center in U.K.

text.p: Mobil Corp said on Monday that it sold its Data Center at Maidstone, England, to Computer Sciences Corp.

Mobil issued a statement saying CSC will use Maidstone's facilities to supply information technology services to Mobil's European businesses under a three-year contract with a projected value of around U.S. $55 million, to be implemented after December 1, 1996.

Under the agreement, about 140 people within the existing Mobil operation will transfer to CSC, the statement said. More than 100 of the jobs are at the Maidstone site, the remainder being at various other European locations, the statement said.
Mobil said it will receive an undisclosed cash payment for the Maidstone building and equipment and achieve a reduction in operating costs.
